mode: self red-team (same agent, no fresh context); verified against code where marked
confidence: Design is sound after edits. blind_spot: Proactivity is judged by the owner in conversation, not by unit tests: a well-tested should_ask_journey still nags if the agent ignores the flags or rephrases the ask each turn. Only a real session transcript review (M3) shows it.
overreach: Absorbing E73 plus two route changes plus a new procedure in one epic is at the edge of 'no added surface'; if the owner rejects U3, S84.3 shrinks to the recommender rules without the memory/index and E73 keeps the rest.
